Wonderul modern Italian place. Not like anywhere else in town.
Jul 2026 • Friends
Unassuming place on the main road but high quality decor and great ambience, welcome, music, layout.
Menu very appealing - planning to come back for a second night in this short breqk. Scallops a feature, salads, burrata of two sizes, pasta and pizza. Real pizza oven in view. Reasonable prices too, and the option of half-half of your two favourite pizza toppings. Chilli oil and tabasco on the table. 

Really nice evening, good lighting, sensitive service. Prices clearly shown don’t include 7% VAT but that is probably normal here. 

Clientele a mix of western Brits and Australians, Indians, and Chinese on the night we went. 
Decent cocktail, beer, wine and mocktail menu.

Very happy to recommend for an Italian experience, some dishes with a Phu Quoc twist, like local scallops and crab.
